provenance: This working directory has no Git checkout; precise covered-function fingerprints identify the reviewed source. Do not invent a commit pin.

mapping.Prepare: Store.prepare_release validates/materializes snapshot and transactionally records prepared release
mapping.BeginAdoption: Store.activate confirmation/existence/content checks BEFORE its DB transaction
mapping.CommitAdoption: Store.activate transaction, including rollback-history check; no second content check before commit
mapping.Reconcile: Store.reconcile_active validates active package and atomically replaces pointer AFTER commit
mapping.Crash: Interruption before DB transaction or after committed active/history but before pointer reconciliation
mapping.ChangePackage: External direct write to managed package; no controller OS protection exists
mapping.DevelopmentReport: bench.summarize always labels development release eligibility blocked
mapping.OfflineEligibility: evaluate.review may return eligible_for_trial for supplied scores; no activation edge
mapping.NeverMislabelVerified: Store.activate event/return behavior_verified is false; a local operator confirmation is not independently authenticated approval
mapping.Transaction atomicity: Store.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, commit on success, rollback on exceptions
